capabilities: add colored highlights and notes to selected text in reading and live preview modes
add ruby phonetic annotations to selected text
browse, search and filter annotations across files in a sidebar view
sync and migrate annotation data when files are renamed, deleted or modified
import annotation data from older plugin versions
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese/English). Installation is manual (from Releases or building from source). Embeds and code blocks cannot be annotated yet, per the limitations section. Annotation data moved from JSON files to separate Markdown annotation files in the plugin directory in v3.0.0.
problem: Marking up notes normally means editing the Markdown itself; this keeps the original files untouched by keeping annotation data in separate annotation files.
summary: Annotation plugin that adds colored highlights, inline notes and ruby phonetic annotations to notes while storing annotation data in separate files.
